bea.notes: Annual 2000/2001 use the December 5, 2024 geographic workbook with its own provenance; the current workbook repeats the 2000 label and omits 2001. Later years use the current release.

comtrade.notes: U.S.-reported customs trade: exports FOB, imports CIF; intentionally not spliced with BEA balance-of-payments series.

hktb.notes: Official HKTDC republication of HKTB arrivals. Nationality, not residence, all purposes and modes. Browser-rendered public report text retained with checksum; no challenge bypass. C&SD/MGTO republications restore 2000-2022 residence history as a separate comparability segment; charts break at 2023 and cross-definition changes/indices are unavailable. MGTO provides direct matched first-half 2025/2026 nationality totals. NTTO air estimates remain separate.
hktb.vintage: HKTB residence arrivals 2000-2022; nationality 2023-2025 and January-June 2025/2026

iie.notes: IIE automatic retrieval is paused: its terms prohibit automated downloading and analysis. Previously reviewed observations are retained, not newly checked. Separate retrieval and reuse permission has not been verified; public access is not commercial-use clearance.

macau_tourism.notes: Direct 2025/2026 monthly and cumulative source-market tables, supplemented by complete U.S. first-half profiles when a monthly top-ten row is absent; travel-document issuing place, not U.S. residence. All twelve 2025 monthly counts reconcile with the December cumulative total. A requested September 2026 report still displays August captions and is not mislabelled. Original DSEC 2002 table 1 restores 2001/2002 all-mode residence arrivals before the 2008 worker/student exclusion. Other annual history retained.
macau_tourism.vintage: DSEC 2001-2002; full monthly 2025 and monthly/YTD through August 2026

moe.notes: Reported U.S.-nationality degree and non-degree students, not U.S. credit-program participants or tertiary degree-only counts. Historical snapshots do not establish later enrollment. CAU's original yearbook/MOE research table restores seven earlier/intermediate years; 2011, 2012 and 2014 overlap exactly with retained ministry reports. The reviewed 2017 ministry briefing ranks source countries without a U.S. count, so no number is inferred. Original statistical aggregates only; reports are not redistributed.
moe.vintage: MOE reporting years 2006-2016 and 2018; original and explicitly attributed republications

nbs_tourism.notes: Official China Statistical Yearbooks 2007, 2010, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2018 and 2019. Selected historical source vintages; source units converted from 10,000 person-times. Later bilateral all-mode counts are not verified here. Not leisure-only visitors, unique people, U.S. departures, or a series spliced to U.S. resident air-travel estimates.

ntto.notes: Workbook modification dates are not official publication dates.

ntto_siat.notes: U.S.-resident air-travel destination estimates, kept separate from all-mode visitor arrivals. Annual 2019 and 2022–2025; separately selected Q1-Q2 observations in 2025 and 2026 support matched January–June comparisons. Quarter checkboxes are selected directly, not inferred by subtracting rounded annual and half-year totals. Monitor total-traveler and respondent cards read from the public report with explicit year, quarter and destination filters; source checksums identify retained browser-visible report text, not API responses. Estimates are rounded to 1,000; respondent counts appear in each observation's notes. Under-100 respondent bases are conservatively flagged low reliability. No 2020–2021 estimates or invented zeros; no aggregation across destinations.
ntto_siat.vintage: NTTO SIAT public monitor, 6 October 2026; through 2026 Q2

taiwan_tourism.notes: Public open-data CSV; scope differs from NTTO overnight trips.

uis.notes: Taiwan not separately listed; U.S.-to-mainland records may be absent.

ustr.notes: Separate direct USTR country estimates fill Macau services missing from the selected BEA workbook. Exports, imports, total services and surplus/deficit are checked together. Rounded nominal USD; not regional allocations or affiliate sales. Longer history not imputed.
ustr.vintage: USTR Macau Trade Summary; directly reported 2025 estimated services
